description:
Configure the existing survey titled 'Sparkling Water Concept Test - Wave 3' for a consumer panel launch. You must modify the General, Presentation, and Publication settings to meet these exact requirements:

1. Navigation: Set format to 'Question by Question', enable the progress bar, DISABLE the 'Previous' button (no going back), and hide the 'No answer' option.
2. Text Elements: 
   - Welcome message: 'Welcome to the Sparkling Water Concept Evaluation. You will be shown a new beverage concept and asked to share your honest reactions. This survey takes approximately 7 minutes. Your individual responses are confidential and will be reported only in aggregate. Please read each concept description carefully before answering.'
   - End message: 'Thank you for completing the concept evaluation. Your feedback directly influences our product development decisions. Your responses have been recorded and will remain strictly confidential.'
   - End URL: 'https://panel.researchportal.com/complete?status=1&sid={SID}'
3. Notifications: Send basic admin notifications to 'concept-alerts@beverageco.com'.
4. Scheduling: Set the Start Date to February 1, 2025 and Expiry Date to March 15, 2025.

Navigate to the survey settings panels to apply all changes.
